facts.prone-figure: A person lies face down with ten swords stuck in the back.
facts.red-cloth: A red cloth (a cloak) spreads out under the body.
facts.hand-gesture: The one hand showing has two fingers extended.
facts.dark-sky: The sky above is pitch black.
facts.yellow-horizon: A band of yellow light hangs at the horizon.
facts.calm-water: Calm water and distant mountains can be seen behind.

glosses.yellow-horizon: The dawn light on the horizon at the darkest hour.
glosses.calm-water: The stillness after it is over.

reversedGloss.waning: The darkest time has passed, and he rises slowly.
reversedGloss.blocked: Unable to accept that it is over, he cannot stand up.
reversedGloss.excess: Going over the pain again and again deepens the wound.

misdescriptions.wrong: He lies in a sea of blood.
Nine swords are stuck in him.
